title: AgentTune: A Unified Training Lifecycle for Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. translated_title: AgentTune：面向工具使用型大语言模型智能体的统一训练生命周期
translated_abstract: 工具使用型智能体日益需要一个共同的底层基础来构建、训练、评估、蒸馏和维护智能体系统，然而现有工具通常只是孤立地处理这些阶段。我们提出了AgentTune，一个源码开放的Python库，它为开发和优化工具使用型智能体提供了统一框架。AgentTune的核心是一种两层EventLog表示，它在保留智能体轨迹的同时，支持为训练、评估和审计提供一致的投影。基于这一底层基础，该库提供了共享的智能体运行时、工具调用强化学习、智能体蒸馏、检索增强生成、决策工作流、评估工具，以及通往自我修复智能体的设计路径。这些组件通过可组合的接口暴露出来，使智能体策略、训练方法、评估流程和恢复机制能够灵活组合使用。
tldr: 提出了AgentTune——一个统一的开源Python框架，通过两层EventLog表示整合了工具使用型LLM智能体从构建、训练、评估到蒸馏、维护的全生命周期流程。
en_tdlr: AgentTune is a unified open-source Python framework that integrates the full lifecycle of tool-using LLM agents—from building, training, and evaluation to distillation and maintenance—through a two-tier EventLog representation.
